question: In a 3 races, 2 genders and 5 in each treatment group for two-way ANOVA, the degree of freedom for source of variation due to interaction, error and total respective are
solution:
The correct answer is** (2,24,29).**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **In a **two-way ANOVA**, the degree of freedom (df) is the number of values in a sample that are free to vary.
 
• The df for source of variation due to interaction is calculated by multiplying the degrees of freedom (df) for each factor and subtracting 1.
 
• In this case, there are 2 races and 2 genders, so df for interaction = (2-1)*(2-1) = 2.
 
• The df for error is calculated as the total number of observations minus the number of parameters estimated. In this case, there are 5 observations in each group
 
• the total number of observations is 3*2*5 = 30.
 
• The number of parameters estimated is 2 (for race and gender) plus 2 (for interaction), so df for error = x = {-b pm sqrt{b²-4ac} over 2a}
 
• The total df is equal to the total number of observations minus 1, which is 30 - 1 = 29.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In a 2-way **ANOVA**, the degrees of freedom for the source of variation due to interaction is calculated as (number of levels of one factor - 1) * (number of levels of the other factor - 1).
 
• In this case, the number of levels of one factor is 3 (races) and the number of levels of the other factor is 2 (genders)
 
• so the degree of freedom for the interaction is (3-1) * (2-1) = 2
 
• The **degree of freedom for error **is calculated as the total number of observations minus the number of treatments.
 
• In this case, the total number of observations is 3 races * 2 genders * 5 in each treatment group = 30
 
• so the degree of freedom for error is 30 - 3 = 27.
 
• The total degree of freedom is calculated as the sum of the degrees of freedom for interaction and error. In this case, the total degree of freedom is 2 + 27 = 29.
 
• So the answer is (2,24,29)
